newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Forex gains limited profit fall - UM.
newsitem.headline: Forex gains limited profit fall - UM.

text.p: Belgian non-ferrous metals company Union Miniere SA said on Tuesday that exchange rate gains helped limit the pressure of metal prices on first-half profit.

"With few exceptions, metal prices tended to decline or stabilise. But the overall negative impact of metal prices on the operating result compared to first half 1995 was more than offset by the positive impact of exchange rates," UM said.
Lower activity in its transformation sector and diamond industry units after a construction industry downturn hit first-half 1996 profits, UM said in its earnings statement.
Its transformation businesses include cobalt, germanium and zinc sheet production.
The company noted that its Swedish zinc mine, Ammeberg, had not contributed to profits in the six months to June 30, since it was sold in August 1995.
The contribution to operating profit from Diamond Boart, the synthetic diamond-making subsidiary of Sibeka, fell by 160 million Belgian francs due to increased competition in depressed markets.
